text:
cleo: Quick question — our sample app typing is leaking `any` for responses when users don't pass a generic to client.generate. This causes downstream apps to lose type safety. Thoughts?

mike: That's because we have two overloads and the non-generic one wins during inference. Overloads + generics are brittle across TS versions.

mike: Suggestion: one generic signature `generate<T = unknown>(opts: GenOpts<T>): Promise<GenResp<T>>` and use a discriminant like `kind: 'text'|'json'` inside GenOpts. Keeps inference flow and defaults to unknown.

cleo: `unknown` is a good default. But some users prefer ergonomics over safety. Any docs snippet to show how to opt into typed responses?

ana: Add a short sample: `const resp = await client.generate<MyType>({kind:'json', input: {...}}); const data = resp.output as MyType;` and show pattern with a runtime validator (zod) for production.

devon: Build-wise, watch tsconfig: `declaration: true` + `isolatedModules: true` is incompatible for tsc emit. Our samples use `tsconfig.sample.json` with `declaration:false` and let CI run `tsc --emitDeclarationOnly` separately.

cleo: Also hit an esbuild error when using `preserveValueImports: true` — it elided a side-effect import we relied on. Turning it off for the sample fixed it. Noted in README.

ci-bot: ci: sample-build passed for node 18 but edge-runner (netlify) failed earlier with `ReferenceError: require is not defined`. https://ci/99999

mike: That's packaging. Add an `exports` map: `{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs","./edge":"./dist/worker.mjs"}` and provide a tiny `redwood-sdk/edge` re-export that always points at ESM.

cleo: Plan: 1) change signature to single generic + discriminant, 2) default generic to unknown, 3) add edge entry + sample tsconfig, 4) update README with opt-in typed example + validator note. I'll open a devex PR and tag @mike for typing review.

mike: Happy to review the typings patch. Also add a short changelog entry about `unknown` default so users aren't surprised.

cleo: Thanks everyone — will post PR link when ready.
